item.text: The key boundary is workflow completion versus acceptance: the agent produces a ready proposal, then a separate operation checks the originals and publishes it. I'll center the tree on that flow, distinguish the two agent steps from subsequent validation, and trim routine implementation details.

{"ascii":"Git Change Proposals: capture evidence -> edit isolated proposal -> review -> accept
|-- [M] Push intake: PushIntegrationService delegates Git resolution to GitPushSource
|   |-- receive(connectionId, event): identity = connectionId + eventId
|   |   |-- Matching delivery shares pending work or returns stored generation
|   |   `-- Reused identity with different event -> conflict
|   |-- New generation requires enabled connection + application
|   |   `-- Non-branch, deletion, unchanged endpoint, or unchanged tree -> skipped
|   |-- [D] Git resolution uses pinned before/after commits in a matching checkout
|   |   |-- Fetch missing endpoints; reject unavailable commits or incomplete history
|   |   |-- Commit selection = reachable(after) minus reachable(before)
|   |   `-- Net change = endpoint trees differ; new branch uses empty-tree baseline
|   |       `-- Moving branch HEAD and event-supplied commit lists do not determine selection
|   `-- Net change -> workflow.start(repositoryId, commits, head, comparisonBase)
|       `-- Generation ID becomes requestId; stored run ID links later status refreshes
|-- [D] Frozen capture: ChangeSessionService.capture supplies analysis and proposal creation
|   |-- Repository context -> captured Git hunks
|   |-- Settled representations in that repository -> saved canvas baselines
|   |   `-- Selected live workspace snapshots replace matching saved baselines
|   |       `-- Multiple live workspaces require canvasId; repository drift rejects capture
|   |-- Alternative: baselineChangeSessionId -> original baselines + original pinned hunks
|   |   `-- Reset proposed copies/history; previous proposal edits are excluded
|   `-- Capture retains document/representation IDs and saved revision expectations
|       `-- Capturing alone does not create a proposal
|-- [C] DiffSessionWorkflowService: turn captured evidence into a ready proposal
|   |-- start -> persist run -> execute in background
|   |   `-- Run ID derives from requestId; matching starts replay, differing requests conflict
|   |-- capture -> require pinned context and nonempty hunks -> open agent session
|   |   `-- DiffSessionTools receives capture, source reader, proposal service and agent canvas service
|   |-- runAgentWorkflow invokes agent steps: analyze -> materialize
|   |   `-- Store prompts, step requests/responses, conversation and performance artifacts
|   |-- After workflow returns: service loads result.changeSessionId
|   |   `-- Must equal the proposal created through these tools and have status ready
|   |       `-- Run becomes completed: proposal is available for review; acceptance is separate
|   `-- [O] Service retains active abort controllers and live run state
|       |-- cancel aborts the run; shutdown aborts active runs and disposes runtime
|       |-- Caught execution error -> cancelled if aborted, otherwise failed
|       |-- Finally attempts artifact writes, session disposal and run save
|       `-- Execution settlement removes live entries; stored running run without local activity
|           `-- get reports interrupted
|-- [M] Proposal workspace: ChangeSessionService exposes edits; controllers/history stay internal
|   |-- create clones capture into a draft; proposal ID derives from projectId + requestId
|   |   `-- Stored creation signature guards replay, including supplied capture identity
|   |-- [O] Each document retains baseline + proposed copy + forked undo/redo history
|   |   `-- New document has no baseline; editing proposed state leaves live originals unchanged
|   |-- apply -> shared MappingDocumentController -> record proposed state/history
|   |   |-- Document version guards controller edits; session version guards proposal updates
|   |   `-- Serialize mutations per session; increment session version and persist result receipt
|   |       `-- Matching receipt replays before mutation version checks; changed signature conflicts
|   |-- [D] Review changes derive from baseline versus proposed state
|   |   |-- No baseline -> new canvas; changed selections/reviews -> subtree variants
|   |   |-- Changed diagram display or incident edges -> existing/added diagram change
|   |   `-- Stable change IDs preserve annotations; replacements must cover all generated changes
|   |-- Content/history, DiffTree or migration edits reset to draft unless revalidated as ready
|   `-- Request ready -> validateReady
|       |-- Require changes, valid DiffTree/migrations, repository agreement and valid edge anchors
|       |-- Added diagram requires incoming edge from a diagram present in its baseline
|       `-- dependsOn IDs must exist and be acyclic: review prerequisites, not an execution schedule
|-- [C] Separate acceptance: ChangeSessionService.accept(requestId, expectedVersion)
|   |-- Serialize per session; existing acceptance replays only for matching request/version
|   |-- Require expected session version + ready status; revalidate readiness
|   |-- Select affected documents from review changes
|   |   `-- Across project workspaces, compare matching live originals that have baselines
|   |       `-- Document content or name differs from capture -> conflict; create a new proposal
|   |-- Call projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges: catalog publication boundary
|   |   `-- Transfer affected proposed documents/history, saved revision expectations,
|   |       document/representation IDs, change IDs and accepted session version
|   `-- [O] Returned catalog acceptance receipt is authoritative
|       |-- finishAcceptance saves accepted status at receipt.sessionVersion + 1
|       |-- Catalog published but session write failed -> receipt supports recovery
|       |   `-- list/preview project accepted status; get/accept repair the full record
|       `-- Accepted and archived proposals reject new edits
`-- [M] Proposal persistence and review: ChangeSessionRecords hides its record layout
    |-- Save boundary: immutable document/history/receipt/DiffTree records -> publish manifest
    |   |-- Reuse unchanged references; shared DiagramPersistence stores diagram revisions
    |   `-- Serialize by project/session; supplied expected manifest token detects stale writes
    |       `-- This publishes proposal records; acceptance publishes through the catalog above
    |-- Read boundary: summary omits bodies/history/receipts; preview loads baseline + proposal
    |   `-- Full read restores history and replay receipts; domain validators check stored contracts
    |-- DiffTree mappings resolve nodes to captured hunks for review
    `-- [D] Treemaps combine stored DiffTree + document previews at one session version
        `-- Check preview versions and final summary; concurrent change -> retry conflict"}
